summary: For the fixed simple-spectrum target A=H diag(1,2,-3,1/2) H^T with normalized 4x4 Hadamard H, independent cap-one product inputs f1=1_{union_{j=1}^M[10j,10j+1/M]}, f2=f3=f4=1_[0,1] satisfy E ||rho_{123|Q'}||_infinity^(2/3) >= (M/2)^(2/3), where Q'=Y4^2/2. Thus the scalar-weighted positive conditional-height moment is not dimension-free even on one fixed target matrix. Account03/B15's fixed-matrix C0 theorem keeps the actual output density uniformly bounded in M, so this refutes only the proof interface. A viable scalar-conditioning route must retain the translations/overlap of conditional profiles before taking the output supremum.
